description.zh:
备份集ID。
> * 查询时，`BackupId`和`RestoreTime`参数必选其一传入。
> * 您可以通过[DescribeBackups](~~98102~~)接口查看备份集ID。
description.en:
The ID of the backup set.

> - You must specify either the `BackupId` or `RestoreTime` parameter.
>
> - Call the [DescribeBackups](~~98102~~) operation to query the backup set ID.

description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以通过[DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~)接口查询账号下所有集群的信息详情。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters in your account.

description.zh:
传入具体的数据库名称（如`test_db`）以获取目标数据库所有支持恢复的数据表名称。
> * 每次仅支持传入一个数据库名称。
> * 若该参数留空，您可以查看当前备份集下所有支持恢复的数据库名称，但无法查看各数据库下对应的数据表名称。
description.en:
The name of the database, such as `test_db`. If you specify this parameter, the names of all tables that can be recovered from the specified database are returned.

> - You can specify only one database name at a time.
>
> - If you do not specify this parameter, the names of all databases that can be recovered from the current backup set are returned. The names of tables in each database are not returned.

description.zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100** Default value: **30**.

description.zh: 实例所在地域ID，您可以调用[DescribeDBClusterAttribute](~~2319132~~)查询。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeDBClusterAttribute](~~2319132~~) to query the region ID.

description.zh:
还原时间点，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ（UTC时间）。
>查询时，`BackupId`和`RestoreTime`参数必选其一传入。您可以通过[DescribeBackups](~~98102~~)接口查看还原时间点。
description.en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> You must specify either the `BackupId` or `RestoreTime` parameter. Call the [DescribeBackups](~~98102~~) operation to query the point in time for restoration.

title.zh: 查看支持恢复的库表信息详情

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-meta-list --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --backup-id 111111 --restore-time 2020-10-04T01:40:00Z --get-db-name test_db --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region-code cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
